statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. The listed Filebeat versions 8.19.19, 9.3.8, and 9.4.4 contain the upstream fix; Scout reports them because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats module PURLs.

CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. The listed Filebeat versions 8.19.19, 9.3.8, and 9.4.4 contain the upstream fix; Scout reports them because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats module PURLs.
CVE-2025-68383 is reported against broad elastic/beats Go module PURLs. The listed Filebeat image versions do not contain the vulnerable Filebeat parser/dissect implementation reported by this CVE.

CVE-2025-68383 was fixed upstream in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. All listed versions include the fix. Docker Scout incorrectly reports this as unfixed due to PURL version range matching issues with the elastic/beats Go module path.
